name: dataset
description: A dataset (obo:IAO_0001000, data collection) is described by value nodes reached with obo:IAO_0000235, composed with obo:BFO_0000051 (has part), and related to its subject matter with obo:IAO_0000136 (is about). Creators and affiliations are modelled as ordered list individuals rather than repeated literals.
